description: Administrative interface for managing organizational hierarchy and partner tree structure. Allows viewing, editing, and organizing partner categories and groups in a hierarchical tree format.

pages.name: PartnerTreeComponent
pages.description: This page provides the administrative interface for managing your organization's hierarchical structure. You can view, edit, and organize partner categories and groups in a tree-like format, allowing for clear visualization and management of your business relationships and internal structures.

buttons.label: New Partner Level
buttons.description: Opens a dialog to create a new organizational node, such as a category, group, or level, within the partner hierarchy tree.
when_to_use: When you need to add a new organizational category to the partner tree structure.
When you need to add a new group to the partner tree structure.
When you need to add a new level to the partner hierarchy.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're unsure how to proceed, use the tree view to navigate the organizational structure. Click the '+' button to create new partner levels. Use the expand/collapse controls (arrows next to nodes) to view different levels of the hierarchy. To edit details of an existing partner level, simply click on its row in the tree.
common_tasks: Creating partner levels: Click the 'New Partner Level' button to add new organizational nodes to your hierarchy.
Editing partner structure: Click on any existing tree node (partner level) to open its details for modification.
Managing hierarchy: Utilize the tree structure to organize and reorder partner categories and groups as needed.
Viewing organizational structure: Expand and collapse nodes within the tree to explore different levels of your hierarchy.
Administrative management: Configure and maintain organizational relationships and reporting structures within the tree.
